description: Detects event-loop overhead in a V8 CPU profile by identifying V8 internal frames that represent async machinery — microtask queue processing, nextTick saturation, and timer/immediate callbacks. These frames are invisible to most profilers but consume real CPU when promise chains are deep or nextTick is overused. Use to answer: is the bottleneck async orchestration overhead rather than synchronous computation?

threshold_percent.description: Async overhead percentage above which a warning is emitted in the verdict (default: 10)

name: analyze_async_bottlenecks
